en.title: [Talent Development Team] Special Lecture for Public Service Aptitude Test (PSAT) Preparation
summary: Hosting of a special lecture and information session for the Public Service Aptitude Test (PSAT) to prepare for national civil service exams.
Information session schedule: September 29, 2026 (Tue) 18:30 ~ 21:30, Hi-Tech Center Room 230.
Mock exam & special lecture schedule: October 31 (Sat), November 1 (Sun), November 7 (Sat), 2026, 13:00 ~ 19:00, Student Union Building Room 346.
Benefits: Free textbooks and tuition for the first 50 participants.
Application method and period need to be checked via the attached image (not specified in the text).
en.easyExplanation: An information session, mock exams, and special lectures will be held for students preparing for the national civil service exam (PSAT). The information session will take place on September 29 at the Hi-Tech Center, and the lectures will be held in October and November at the Student Union Building. Textbooks and tuition are provided free of charge for the first 50 participants.
en.eventInfo: PSAT Preparation Information Session at Hi-Tech Center Room 230, and Mock Exams/Lectures at Student Union Building Room 346

originalContent:
1. 목적 및 기대효과
가. 국가공무원 채용에서 중요한 공직적격성평가(PSAT) 대비를 통한 학생들의 취업 경쟁력 제고
나. 주요 영역별 전문강사 초빙으로 유형별 문제대응력 향상 도모
2. 추진개요
가. 교육일정 및 장소
- 설명회: 2026. 09. 29.(화) 18:30 ~ 21:30 / 하이테크 230호
- 모의고사 및 특강: 2026. 10. 31.(토), 11. 01.(일), 11. 07.(토) 13:00 ~ 19:00 / 학생회관 346호
나. 대상인원: 선착순 50명(교재 및 교육비 무료)
